build_incremental_decoder: build a python module that subclasses FairseqIncrementalDecoder to implement custom incremental decoding logic
implement_forward_method: implement the forward method of FairseqIncrementalDecoder to process prev_output_tokens with encoder_out and incremental_state
implement_extract_features: implement the extract_features method of FairseqIncrementalDecoder to return decoder features of shape batch tgt_len embed_dim
reorder_incremental_state: reorder the incremental state dictionary during beam search by calling reorder_incremental_state_scripting on the decoder
set_beam_size: set the beam size on a FairseqIncrementalDecoder and all its child modules using set_beam_size
